rationale: tools/truncate.ts truncateTail(content, {maxBytes?, maxLines?}): Go TruncateTail(content, maxBytes, maxLines int). The two options are positional, covering every upstream option; an absent option is the caller passing DefaultMaxBytesUpstream or DefaultMaxLinesUpstream, and zero is a real zero limit, as `options.maxBytes ?? DEFAULT` treats 0 (TestTruncateZeroLimitsAreLimits).
tools/truncate.ts truncateHead(content, {maxBytes?, maxLines?}): Go TruncateHead(content, maxBytes, maxLines int), positional with the same absent-option rule as truncateTail.
tools/truncate.ts formatSize(bytes) is FormatSize(bytes int) string.

tools/truncate.ts truncateLine(line, maxChars?) returns {text, wasTruncated}; Go TruncateLine(line, maxChars) returns (string, bool), the caller passing GrepMaxLineLengthUpstream for an absent maxChars.
tools/truncate.ts TruncationResult: Go TruncationResult with the same eleven members and json keys; truncatedBy null is the empty string.
